steps.content: Now I'll filter to September 2026 charge dates and SubAccountName `staging`, then rank services by total `BilledCost`.

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
df['ChargePeriodStart'] = pd.to_datetime(df['ChargePeriodStart'])
mask = (df['SubAccountName'] == 'staging') & (df['ChargePeriodStart'].dt.to_period('M') == pd.Period('2026-09', freq='M'))
filtered = df.loc[mask]
print('Filtered rows:', len(filtered))
print('ChargeCategory values:', filtered['ChargeCategory'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print('BilledCost nulls:', filtered['BilledCost'].isna().sum())
print('ServiceName nulls:', filtered['ServiceName'].isna().sum())
ranked = filtered.groupby('ServiceName', dropna=False)['BilledCost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(ranked.to_string())
